query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tenant_invitations) as total_invitations,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tenant_invitations WHERE accepted_at IS NULL AND expires_at > NOW()) as pending_invitations,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tenant_invitations WHERE accepted_at IS NULL AND expires_at < NOW()) as expired_invitations,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM claim_approvals WHERE claim_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM claims)) as dangling_approvals,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM claims c WHERE c.status = 'completed' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_assessments a WHERE a.claim_id = c.id)) as completed_without_assessment,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM claims c WHERE c.status IN ('comparison','repair_assigned') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_assessments a WHERE a.claim_id = c.id)) as advanced_without_assessment,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM claims WHERE damage_photos IS NULL OR damage_photos = '' OR damage_photos = '[]') as claims_without_photos;
